arms.stack: the tiered core as the app runs it
arms.chart_reader: the frontier model (Claude Sonnet) given the question and the full text of the same documents the stack selected, in one prompt, asked to answer directly

rule: Both arms answer the same question over the same documents. Stack: the answer rows must equal the reference. Chart reader: the count, the document list or the per-document values must equal the reference; a value that contains the reference value is accepted. This is not a test of ChatGPT, Epic or any other product.
